title: Topic 17
japanese_text: 佐藤さんはいつも<u>古典</u>の教科書の挿絵に落書きをしている。教科書のページをめくったときに、落書きがちょうど先生にばれてしまい、カラーペンを<u>没収</u>されていた。
english_translation: Sato is always doodling on the illustrations in his classics textbook. When he turned over the page of his textbook, his doodles were discovered by his teacher, who confiscated his color pen.
